+    def _execute_request(self, method: str, url: str, params: Dict[str, Union[str, List[str]]], headers: Dict[str, str], json: Dict[str, Any]) -> _PycurlResponse:
+        response_body = io.BytesIO()

+        status_code = 0
+
+        def capture_headers(line: bytes):
+            nonlocal response_headers, status_code
+            decoded_line = line.decode("iso-8859-1").strip()
+            if not decoded_line:
+                return
+            if decoded_line.startswith("HTTP/"):
+                response_headers = {}
+                parts = decoded_line.split(" ", 2)
+                if len(parts) > 1:
+                    try:

+                    except ValueError:

+                return
+            if ":" in decoded_line:
+                header_name, header_value = decoded_line.split(":", 1)
